svg.title: Golden Paths
svg.desc: Golden Paths. A paved, supported route for common tasks: one template creates a service with its pipeline, infrastructure and monitoring. Step 1, 40 services, 40 ways: Returns starts as a copy: a deprecated base image, no alerts, no owner, 9 working days to staging. Step 2, The golden path at work: Four fields, one template: repo, pipeline, deployment, DB, queue, alerts, owner; staging in 20 min. Step 3, Kept current, optional: Template v4 arrives as upgrade PRs: 27 of 32 merged within 7 days; 8 services stay off the path. Step 4, Pitfalls and limits: Pitfalls: a golden cage, templates that rot, too many paths, day one only, counting template runs.

g.text: Returns starts as a copy: a deprecated base image, no alerts, no owner, 9 working days to staging.
Four fields, one template: repo, pipeline, deployment, DB, queue, alerts, owner; staging in 20 min.
Template v4 arrives as upgrade PRs: 27 of 32 merged within 7 days; 8 services stay off the path.
Pitfalls: a golden cage, templates that rot, too many paths, day one only, counting template runs.
